description: Trigger: import/reindex.rs extract_message_id_bytes only matches the literals 'Message-ID:' and 'Message-Id:'. RFC 5322 requires case-insensitive header name matching; valid capitalizations like 'message-id:', 'MESSAGE-ID:', or 'Message-id:' are not matched. Bad behavior: articles with non-canonical Message-ID capitalization are silently skipped during reindex, leaving their CIDs unmapped in msgid_map. The articles are stored in IPFS but unreachable by Message-ID lookup.
title: reindex.rs Message-ID extraction is not case-insensitive
